job.title: Digital Infrastructure Traineeship
job.description:
About MobReady
MobReady are a socially inclusive, Supply Nation certified, Aboriginal owned Group Training Organisation with a commitment to connecting our Mob with a sustainable career through trainee & apprentice opportunities across NSW & ACT. As an Aboriginal organisation, we understand the importance of providing mentoring & support as you kickstart your new journey. 
 
 
The Role: 
The Infrastructure Trainee supports the Bank's Infrastructure team while completing a structured traineeship
program. The role provides practical experience across systems administration, server technologies,
virtualisation, network engineering and infrast ructure support services. The trainee develops foundational
technical knowledge and workplace skills to prepare for progression into Infrastructure Systems
Administration or Network Engineering roles.

Key Accountabilities

Infrastructure Support
- Assist with the operation, monitoring and maintenance of the Bank's technology infrastructure.
- Support routine maintenance, testing, upgrades and service delivery activities.
- Assist with investigating and resolving technology issues under guidance.
- Develop an understanding of server, network and security technologies.
 
Administration
- Maintain accurate records and technical documentation.
- Support reporting and administrative activities.
- Follow security, governance and change management processes.
 
Learning and Development
- Complete all requirements of the traineeship qualification.
- Participate in coaching, training and workplace learning activities.
- Build knowledge of infrastructure technologies, including servers, networks, operating systems and
virtualisation platforms.
- Apply learning from formal training in the workplace.
- Demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and professional development. 
 
Selection Criteria:
- Identify as Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander - Confirmation of Aboriginality or a stat dec is required.
- Genuine interest in technology
- Pass a police check
- Basic computer skills
- Completed year 12 or equivalent 

This is a targeted position under the anti-Discrimination Act 1977 persons of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent are encouraged to apply and preference for the role. 
 
If this sounds like you, APPLY NOW!

Brittney Simpson
Field Officer
